annotations.title: Save a search with email alerts

description:
Save a property search on PropertyList for a person, with email alerts when new listings match.
Takes the same filters as search_properties (location or location_id, search_type, property_types,
bedrooms, bathrooms, price, the pool feature). The person must confirm by email: PropertyList emails
them a link, and the search is saved (and their free PropertyList account made, or opened, with no
password) only when they open it. Tell them to check their email. Ask for their email address and
whether they want alerts (daily, weekly by default, every two weeks, monthly, or none). Filters
saved searches cannot hold are listed in not_kept. To see, change or delete saved searches later,
use manage_saved_searches.

alert_frequency.description: How often new matches are emailed; none saves it without alerts.

email.description: The person's email address; the confirmation link goes to it.

features.description: pool is kept; other features are not, and come back in not_kept.

language.description: The person's language, for the email and the alerts.

location_id.description: Area id from autocomplete_location. Takes precedence over location.

property_types.description: One slug, as in search_properties (apartments, villas, penthouses, townhouses, plots, country-houses, commercial or a commercial page such as offices). Several types save as all homes.

name: save_search

not_kept.description: Filters a saved search cannot hold.

summary.description: The search as it will be saved.
